test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Venu is a great / storyteller and can / makes up a story / on the spot.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**makes up a story.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Modal verbs such as '**can**', '**could**', '**would**', '**should**', etc., are always followed by the **base form** (infinitive form without '**to**') of the **main verb**.
 
• In the incorrect sentence, the verb '**makes**' appears after '**can**'.
 
• However, it should be the base form '**make**', not the third person singular form '**makes**'.
 
• The proper construct is '**can make**' and not '**can makes**' because '**make**' is the base form which follows a modal verb.
 
• The correct phrase would be "*Venu is a great storyteller and can **make up a story** on the spot*".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Remember that misplacing verbs in their correct form could change the entire meaning or make the sentence grammatically incorrect.
 
• Always ensure to use the correct form of the verb depending on the structure and context of the sentence.
